newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African bonds steady, Stals comments encourage.
newsitem.headline: S.African bonds steady, Stals comments encourage.

text.p: 0728 GMT - Long bonds steady near overnight levels in subdued early trade after bevy of economic data data over last few days. Rand drifting weaker with players seen buying dollars into any dips during the day.

* Market encouraged by Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals indicating bank hopeful of rate cut by year-end, which dealers say supports general feeling that rate cut still on the cards within next month.
* Benchmark R150 last at 14.14 pct from 14.13 pct at the local close on Tuesday.
* Debt dealers say fairly substantial losses made on Tuesday which subduing speculative activity.
* Intraday range seen between 14.10 to 14.18 pct with investors turning cautious.
* Rand last at 4.5885/5915 vs 4.5880/5910 overnight. Weaker trend seen for rest of week on importer and offshore dollar demand with 4.60 possible by Friday.
